Chaotic Assortment of Faces

  • MediumOil paint on canvas board

Overview

The theme of my AP Art porfolio was chaos. In this piece, I wanted to create a surreal collection of my face showing various different emotional states. I really had fun with this one, and consider it to be one of my best.

Process / Additional Notes

I took several photos of my face and then created a concept for this piece in Adobe Photoshop, then painted this based off my digital reference.
